items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Ken Peplowski wrote the charts. And that was pretty tough because it was all written out.

ctx.x: Yes. Ken Peplowski wrote the charts. And that was pretty tough because it was all written out. And to play the mandolin, now I’m more with the guitar, and someone said, from California, they said why don’t you do what they did out in California like behind Dean Martin and all those recordings, a lot of them used guitar tuning. But I said oh jeez I don’t want to do that because then it might not sound right. So I kept the mandolin tuning. That’s why Bucky always recommends me, because the tuning is a little more…
Well it’s tiny too, isn’t it?
